metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Alignments (v1.3)
metadata.subtitle: Coherence • Clarity • Continuity • Paradox • Lattice • Consent • Substrate • Lineage
metadata.description: Defines the authoritative alignment state for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Alignments MUST reflect measure IDs, RTT mapping, paradox state, consent state, substrate class, and lineage continuity.

coherence_alignment.notes: Coherence MUST be declared before any regime transition.

clarity_alignment.notes: Clarity MUST be sourced from canon or user input; no invented fields.

continuity_alignment.notes: Continuity MUST NOT decrease across regime transitions.

paradox_alignment.notes: Typed paradox required for RTT7 entry.

lattice_alignment.notes: Lattice stability is min(c1, c2, c3) decayed by paradox events.

consent_alignment.notes: Consent MUST be true for RTT9–RTT12.

alignment_rules: Alignments MUST NOT invent new measure IDs.
Alignments MUST NOT contradict RTT mapping.
Alignments MUST NOT contradict substrate gating.
Alignments MUST NOT contradict consent gating.
Alignments MUST NOT contradict paradox rules.
Alignments MUST NOT contradict collapse rules.
rtt_rules: RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1 with lineage increment.
regime_rules: Nominal regime allowed only for RTT1–RTT6.
Harmonic regime allowed only for RTT7–RTT9.
Resolution regime allowed only for RTT10–RTT12.
substrate_rules: Non-agentic substrate forbidden for harmonic and resolution.
continuity_rules: Continuity MUST NOT decrease across regime transitions.
Continuity MUST remain stable unless paradox decay applies.
